attachments.origin_landmark: medial head: posterior surface above medial condyle; lateral head: posterior surface above lateral condyle
attachments.insertion_landmark: calcaneus (via Achilles/calcaneal tendon, joined by soleus)

actions: flexes knee (crosses both joints, unlike soleus)

functional_compartments.name: Medial head

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: central aponeurosis endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Larger of the two heads; documented independently-controllable EMG compartment from the lateral head (different recruitment during standing balance vs push-off).
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Approximately three-quarters of muscle length -- slightly more proximal than the lateral head, which extends further distally.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity, Part IV -- Distal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(10):508 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17100508 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Lee, Yi and others)

functional_compartments.name: Lateral head

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: central aponeurosis endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Reported as approximately four-fifths of muscle length along this line. Note the line runs proximal to distal, so this zone lies DISTALLY, well below the common practice of injecting the prominent proximal bulk.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity, Part IV -- Distal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(10):508 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17100508 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Lee, Yi and others)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
